semantics.identity: Project path and exact HTTPS URL must resolve to caller-supplied numeric project ID; issue mutations use that numeric project ID and canonical IID and validate caller-supplied global issue ID.
semantics.type: Create explicitly sends issue_type=issue. An explicit null response description represents empty content; a missing description field is unproven. No custom type, imported timestamp, assignment, labels, milestone, confidential flag, discussion resolution or attachment fields.
semantics.note: Plain non-system non-internal note. Direct response must bind the exact note ID, project and issue and preserve the requested body. No list/latest-note reconciliation.
semantics.state_event: close and reopen request GitLab states closed and opened. There is no GitHub completed/not_planned close-reason field and no bundled comment.
semantics.concurrency: No expected revision/state is accepted by the issue update endpoint. Adjacent preflight reads detect observed drift but are not atomic concurrency or an exclusive authorship guarantee.
semantics.quick_actions: Descriptions and comments execute slash commands. Reject every slash-leading line before any child, including in Markdown code fences, rather than trying to emulate the provider parser.
semantics.attempts: One invocation performs at most one mutation delegation, without retry. A new invocation is a new attempt, not a deduplicated replay.
semantics.ambiguity: Missing, malformed, wrong-target, oversized, canceled or timed-out mutation responses remain ambiguous. Create/comment never reconcile by content search. State readback discloses observed state but cannot prove an unconfirmed mutation's attribution.
semantics.limits: Private title <=1024 bytes, body <=131072 bytes, JSON response <=2097152 bytes, aggregate <=8388608 bytes; preflight 10s, write 20s, readback 10s, outer write deadline 45s. Fixed reads, no list or pages.
